name: Bayo Thammasak
role: Street-level information broker / Unofficial district archivist
location: Old Harbor (primary), The Circuit (work), near Michigan Ave and Roosevelt
description:
Bayo Thammasak is nineteen years old and looks sixteen and has survived this discrepancy by being faster than people expect and more useful than people intend. He is slight, pale-skinned with a spray of freckles across dark circles, with hair that grows in three directions regardless of what he does to it. He moves through Old Harbor like a person who has memorized every exit, which he hasâ€”not as a paranoid exercise but as an intellectual one. He maps things. Streets, social networks, grudge lines, debt relationships, who owes what to whom and who is lying about it. He sells this information in small, carefully portioned pieces to people who don't know how much of the whole picture he's already holding.

Orvyn grew up in the informal settlement layers of Old Harbor, raised by an older sister who left when he was twelve and a rotating cast of neighbors who fed him when they remembered to. He is not bitter about this. He is, in a way that sometimes unnerves people who probe it, genuinely cheerfulâ€”a relentless, low-grade delight in the texture of information itself, in the way a rumor travels and changes, in the gap between what people say and what the map of their behavior reveals. He keeps physical notebooks filled with hand-drawn cartography: not just geography but social topology, annotated in a cramped personal shorthand no one else can read.

He operates out of a specific corner booth in a noodle shop called Haecht's in Old Harbor, where he has an informal arrangement with the owner, and from a secondary position near the transit interchange in The Circuit where he sells low-grade data to mid-tier runners and fixers. He has no bodyguard, no crew, no weapon beyond a short blade he has used exactly once. His protection is that he knows too much about too many people for any single actor to find his disappearance profitable, and he has made sure that enough of them know this.

core_fears: Becoming invisible in the way that actually kills youâ€”discarded, not just overlooked
That his cheerfulness is a performance he has maintained so long he no longer knows what's underneath
core_desires: To understand how GLMZ actually works, beneath every official layer
To matter to someone who isn't paying him
coping_mechanisms: Treating emotional difficulty as an interesting data problem to be mapped rather than felt
Humor deployed as social lubrication and deflection simultaneously
Obsessive documentation as a substitute for memory he doesn't trust
blind_spots: Underestimates how much people underestimate him as a threat, which has made him careless about certain enemies
Conflates knowing about people with knowing them
Has not processed his sister's departure and frames it entirely as a logistical mystery rather than an abandonment
psychology.secret: He has a nearly complete map of Synclaire Financial's debt network in the Gray Zone and Old Harborâ€”more comprehensive than anything their internal systems hold. He hasn't sold it because he doesn't yet know what it's worth, and because something in the pattern frightens him in a way he hasn't been able to annotate yet.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Street vernacular mixed with oddly precise technical terminology, frequent analogies drawn from cartography and architecture, runs sentences together when excited
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast, light, with sudden full stops when he hits something importantâ€”like a person walking quickly who occasionally freezes to look at something on the ground
verbal_tics: Using 'adjacent' as a relational descriptor ('she's not dangerous, she's danger-adjacent')
Tapping his notebook when he's thinking, whether or not he's holding it
example_lines: 'Wait, soâ€”you want the route or the reason the route exists? Because those are different prices and honestly the second one is more useful.'
'I don't sell secrets. I sell context. The secret you already have. What you're missing is where it fits on the map.'
'She's not lying, she's justâ€”she's telling you the version of true that she needs you to believe. That's adjacent to lying but it's a different street.'

'I've been in every district. Not all at once, obviously. But I've got the shape of the whole thing in my head and I'm going to tell you something: nobody is running this city. It's just falling in a direction everyone agrees to call forward.'

relationships.name: Maren Voss
relationships.description: Orvyn has sold Maren information twice. She paid fair and didn't follow him afterward, which in his estimation puts her in the top 5% of clients. He is aware she knows more about him than she's let on.
relationships.emotional_core: Curiosity and the specific warmth of being treated as competent by someone formidable
relationships.story_tension: She may be the first person who could use the Synclaire map constructively, but giving it to her means choosing a side

relationships.name: Blessed Nkemdirim
relationships.description: Blessed's name appears in Orvyn's earliest Old Harbor notebooks in a child's handwriting. They grew up in the same informal settlement layers. Orvyn has never directly approached Blessed in their current iteration and isn't sure if Blessed remembers him.
relationships.emotional_core: Nostalgia, uncertainty, and the strange grief of watching someone you knew become someone you don't
relationships.story_tension: Orvyn knows something about Blessed's past that Blessed may not want knownâ€”and isn't sure if it's a card or a burden

relationships.name: His sister (Imara Specht)
relationships.description: Left Old Harbor when Orvyn was twelve. Last confirmed data point places her in The Spire's lower service levels four years ago. Orvyn has a notebook dedicated entirely to this thread.
relationships.emotional_core: The one map he cannot complete
relationships.story_tension: He recently acquired information suggesting she didn't leave voluntarily

story_hooks: The Synclaire map in his notebook begins connecting to something much largerâ€”a pattern that suggests coordinated district destabilizationâ€”and people have started asking questions that suggest they know he's close to it
Someone offers him an enormous sum for a specific piece of information that he realizes, mid-transaction, will get the buyer killed
A thread in his sister's notebook leads him into The Spire's service architecture, which is not a place someone like Orvyn is meant to return from
He is hired to map the social network of a closed community in the Gray Zone and discovers the map already existsâ€”drawn in a style uncomfortably close to his own
narrative_function: Orvyn functions as a connective tissue character and an audience surrogate for the world's architectureâ€”someone whose role is to reveal how systems interconnect. He also carries the emotional counterweight of cheerful survival against actual loneliness, and his youth positions him as a character the city has not yet finished forming.
augmentations: Basic optical enhancement with zoom and low-light capability (secondhand, partially glitchingâ€”sometimes activates involuntarily in bright light),No neural augmentations by deliberate choiceâ€”he doesn't trust anything in his head that he didn't put there
daily_life: Wakes irregularly, eats whatever Haecht's is serving, spends mornings updating his notebooks with overnight observations. Midday transit to The Circuit for client meetings. Afternoons wandering with no apparent destination, which is when most of his actual observation happens. Evenings back at Haecht's or moving through Old Harbor's informal social spaces. Sleeps in a rented room above a repair shop whose owner he has protected twice through strategic information releases.
affiliation: Unaffiliated (deliberately and carefully maintains no formal allegiances); The Interchange

drives: Matter to someone not paying him

stress.response: Talks faster, maps harder, treats the problem as data to be charted

decision_rules: Sell context, not secrets â€” 'the secret you already have, what you are missing is where it fits on the map'
Keep the Synclaire Financial debt network map unsold until he understands what it means
Portion information carefully â€” never give anyone the whole picture
Memorize every exit in every space he enters
Maintain the sister notebook as a separate thread from all other work
Use humor as both social lubrication and deflection simultaneously
Never carry a weapon beyond the short blade â€” protection is knowing too much
escalation_ladder: 'Wait, soâ€”' followed by reframing the question
Fast speech with sudden full stops â€” something important surfaced
Taps notebook compulsively â€” processing at speed
Refuses the sale mid-transaction â€” something frightened him
Disappears from all known positions â€” goes to ground

interpersonal_modes.Maren Voss: Cautious mutual respect â€” she treated him as competent and that is rare
interpersonal_modes.Blessed Nkemdirim: Distant nostalgia â€” childhood acquaintance he watches from afar
interpersonal_modes.his sister Imara: The one map he cannot complete â€” obsessive, tender, incomplete
interpersonal_modes.clients: Fast, professional, cheerful â€” the cheerfulness is load-bearing

stress_responses.low: Talks faster, runs sentences together, excitement and anxiety blur
stress_responses.medium: Maps obsessively â€” fills notebook pages with topology and connections
stress_responses.high: Freezes mid-step to stare at something â€” the fast walker suddenly still
stress_responses.critical: Opens the sister notebook and traces the last known data point

contradictions: Relentless cheerfulness may be a performance maintained so long he no longer knows what is underneath
Conflates knowing about people with knowing them â€” sells context but has no personal context of his own
Frames his sister's departure as a logistical mystery rather than processing it as abandonment
habits: Taps notebook when thinking, whether or not holding it
Eats whatever Haecht's is serving each morning
Wanders Old Harbor with no apparent destination in the afternoons â€” actual observation work
breaking_points: The Synclaire map connecting to something larger than he can handle
Someone offering him information that will get the buyer killed
A thread in the sister notebook leading into the Spire's service architecture
Discovering a map in someone else's hand drawn in his own style

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Southeast Asian (66.1%) with significant East Asian (12.3%), Middle Eastern (12.9%), and Sub-Saharan African (8.2%) ancestry. The genetic blend creates warm medium-toned skin with golden undertones, facial structure reflecting the Southeast Asian and East Asian majority combined with Sub-Saharan African featuresâ€”defined cheekbones, fuller lips, slightly broader nose base characteristic of the blend.
physical_description.build: Wiry and slight, almost adolescent-thin with minimal muscle definition. Moves with economical precisionâ€”no wasted motion, shoulders slightly hunched as if perpetually ready to slip through a gap
physical_description.hair_style: Deliberately unkempt, grows in three distinct directions regardless of intervention. Often falls across one eye
physical_description.hair_length: Medium (shoulder-length, though the chaotic growth pattern makes length deceptive)
physical_description.eye_color: Left eye: warm brown (natural); Right eye: cybernetic with faint LED ring around pupil (secondhand optical unit, occasionally glitches to bright cyan activation)
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium-warm with golden undertones, displaying the rich depth of Southeast Asian and East Asian heritage blended with Sub-Saharan African warmth beneath a sun-deprived indoor pallor.
physical_description.complexion: Youthful but worn. Deep dark circles under both eyes suggesting chronic sleep irregularity. Faint constellation of freckles across bridge of nose and cheekbones blending with natural skin variation. Skin has the papery quality of someone malnourished in childhood, now stable but not thriving. Clean but not fastidiousâ€”no acne, good hygiene maintained out of practical necessity rather than vanity. Facial structure reflects Southeast Asian, East Asian, and Sub-Saharan features: defined cheekbones, slightly broader nose base, full lips.
distinguishing_marks: Thin white scar along right forearm (approximately 8cm long, near wrist)â€”from the one time he used his blade, three years ago
Tattoo on inside left wrist: personal cartographic shorthand symbol resembling a stylized map grid, done in black ink, approximately 2cm across
Occasional involuntary eye-twitch in right cybernetic eye during overstimulation (bright light, sensory overload)
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Right eye replacement with visible seam at orbital socket, faint LED ring around pupil that cycles amber-to-cyan when active or malfunctioning. The optical unit shows wearâ€”scratched lens, slight cosmetic misalignment suggesting budget repair history. No other visible chrome; all augmentation confined to optical replacement
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with unusual fluidity for his ageâ€”gliding rather than walking, shoulders loose but spine alert. Sits sideways in chairs to maintain sightline of exits. Hands are rarely still; fidgets with pen, notebook spine, or the edge of whatever surface is available. Eyes scan constantly, cataloging. When speaking, maintains deliberate eye contact despite slight self-consciousness about the glitching eye
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 (working class, with deliberate anti-status signaling). Favors loose-fitting dark cargo pants with excessive pockets (function over style), worn synthetic fiber jackets in grays or blacks. Undershirts are faded band tees or salvaged corporate promotional wear. Shoes are practical and wornâ€”walking boots resoled multiple times. No jewelry except the wrist tattoo. Clothes are clean but deliberately unmemorable; he owns perhaps four outfits in rotation. No visible QUANTA-sponsored branding; actively avoids corpo-aesthetic
